title: The Cyclin C-CDK8/19 Mediator kinase module controls PRCC-TFE3 driven senescence in renal epithelium and tumorigenesis in TFE3-RCC
model: HK-2 renal epithelial cells with inducible PRCC-TFE3, Brunello knockout library
contrast: PRCC-TFE3 induced vs not induced, paired by run (2 vs 2)
paper_calls: CCNC (Cyclin C) required for PRCC-TFE3 senescence
named_hits: CCNC missed (rank 1,521; 2 of 4 guides dropped); MED12 #8; CDKN1A #2
verdict: CCNC knockouts are absent from both control libraries and present in both induced libraries, but BARCS misses them: two guides with all-zero controls fail to converge and are dropped, and the remaining guides are shrunk toward a library-wide variance set by one bottlenecked library. This is a BARCS limitation, not weak data.
